title: Placement
description: right: in the band right of the playfield, centred beside the key counter. left: bottom of the left band above the combo counter; its top reaches into the in-game leaderboard's area, so use it when the leaderboard is hidden (Tab) or lower Scale. Results summaries always sit at the right of the header strip.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the meter from its zone (1920×1080 px; positive = right). Use it for skins that move the key counter or HUD.

title: Scale
description: 0.5–2. Scales about the zone's anchor corner.

title: Backing
description: none: numbers float on the game with a slight shadow. scrim: a soft local shade with no edges. panel: the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map: highlights (live bar, mean line, peak) take the current map's colour. 18-lab: always amber. Judgement colours never change.

title: Window / taps
description: How many recent taps the stream speed, interval σ and alternation are measured over (4–64). Speed uses the 1/4 convention: BPM = 15000 ÷ mean interval. The peak only counts runs at least this long; changing the window restarts it.

title: Show finger balance
description: Share of K1 and K2 presses this play.

title: Show judgements
description: 100, 50, miss and slider-break counts during gameplay (osu! does not show them until results).

title: Results summary
description: On the results screen, show peak stream speed, alternation over the play's streams and finger balance (osu! shows none of these).
